task_name: Extend Lower Road Grid, Claim 'My Sweet Town' Journal Reward, and Queue Metal

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When expanding the southern road blocks and when the 'Complete!' banner appears at the bottom of the screen after collecting the 10th Metal for 'My Sweet Town'.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Claiming completed City Journal chapters awards a surprise reward chest containing 400 Simoleons to fund further city expansion.
preconditions: All 3 objectives in 'My Sweet Town' completed (10/10 Metal, 2/2 Nails, 3/3 Residential Zones)
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Draw the connecting horizontal road across the southern block, then claim the journal chest.

steps.who: Roads icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: draw a horizontal road across the lower section of the city to connect the western and eastern roads, then click the green checkmark and close the road menu.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect the finished Metal to complete the journal task.
open the 'My Sweet Town' journal popup.
open the chest and collect 400 Simoleons.
drag Metal into the empty production slots.
